alex: Heads-up — field asked for a minimal on‑prem installer that can run fully offline and has a telemetry opt‑in. Need an acceptance checklist for v1. Any hard blockers?

jamie: Two quick principles: opt‑in only (default off) for telemetry, and bundle must not require outbound to our analytics hosts for install. :thumbsup:

matt_s: Size target? Can we keep the binary <200MB and stream model/artifact blobs after install? If offline, we need an "airgap mode" that accepts local artifact paths. Example CLI: `installer --offline --artifacts /mnt/artifacts --no-telemetry`.

priya: Field asks: preserve customer egress IPs (no NAT rewrite), and no outbound DNS resolution to our cloud for install telemetry. Telemetry should queue to disk and only upload when customer enables. Also require KMS/HSM integration doc for secrets — separate ticket but call out as blocker for some regulated customers.

alex: Agreed on opt‑in & airgap. For acceptance criteria draft: 1) installer can be invoked fully offline, 2) `--no-telemetry` prevents any outbound, 3) telemetry agent stores events under `/var/lib/redwood/telemetry` encrypted, 4) documented KMS/HSM flow, 5) install size < 250MB, 6) automated E2E smoke test with isolated network. Thoughts on thresholds?

jamie: tweak 3) telemetry at rest encryption required, but key management could be customer KMS or local key device. Add an audit log requirement — writes to `/var/log/redwood/install-audit.log`.

matt_s: For 5) let's budget 250MB for v1, but call out roadmap to shrink to <150MB. Also add a compatibility matrix for appliance OSes (RHEL, Ubuntu LTS, Debian).

priya: Add migration/upgrade path: online patching vs offline bundle upgrade. We need a rollback signal if post-upgrade healthcheck fails within 10 mins. Document operator runbook.

alex: Good. Action items: (A) I will draft an acceptance checklist doc and attach risk register, (B) Jamie to draft telemetry encryption + audit log spec, (C) Matt to enumerate installer bundle size options + OS matrix, (D) Priya to write upgrade/rollback runbook stub. I'll present at tomorrow's product sync.

sre-bot: deploybot: build uploaded: `onprem-min-v1-2026-03-22` -> artifacts.redwood.internal/onprem/min/v1 (+metadata).

priya: one more — include a customer-facing opt-in UX for telemetry (CLI + Console) so legal/compliance can sign off.

alex: yup — include CLI prompt and a followup Console checkbox flow. I'll add that to the checklist. :white_check_mark:

jamie: quick note: document must call out network prescriptive baseline for customers (allowed egress, required ports) — even for offline installs we need a clear list for field to validate.

alex: ack. Will add network baseline + sample iptables snippet for airgapped relay.

matt_s: I'll prototype `installer --verify-bundle` that runs preflight checks and emits machine-readable JSON status for CI.

alex: Perfect. Thanks all — meeting invite in 10.
